criterion_text: Agent connects and registers over its Server Token channel, synchronizing its durable Agent Token to Server's **correct current registration identity**; authenticated `server.session.attach` returns only the resolved Agent's token and addresses; direct Agent attach/re-attach and Server→Agent Relay both work using that same Agent Token with no P2P ticket/grant mint or refresh. A stale Agent registration/token cannot overwrite the current generation.

verifiers.summary: The Agent Token synchronizes with its registration generation and is handed off only to the resolved Agent; direct attach and Relay authenticate with it and re-attach never mints

evidence.value: exact target SHA stack: registration cached the newest of two same-identity Agents; attach returned only that Agent token and its addresses; re-attach returned the same value (no mint); direct attach and Server-dialled Relay both authenticated with it; restarting with a new token made it the current generation and the old token was refused
AgentRegisterPayload carries agent_token; server.session.attach returns agent_token; no agent.p2p.grant, mint, grant ACK or connection_token_expires_at exists on this path
